name: Murray AI — P4.2 Slack Approval Handler

parameters.content:
# Phase 4.2 — Slack Approval Handler

Receives Slack events for the approval channel `SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL_ID` (private outreach-approvals channel only). Routes:

- `:white_check_mark:` reaction by approver -> send Claude draft as Gmail reply in original thread.
- Threaded message reply by approver -> send the message text as Gmail reply (overrides Claude draft).
- `:x:` reaction by approver -> mark lead as `Needs Manual Handling` in Monday, post confirmation to approval channel.

## Routing source: Monday Leads Board, NOT Slack metadata
When Phase 4.1 posted the approval card, it persisted the message `ts` + Claude draft to the lead's row on the Leads Board (`Approval Slack TS`, `Pending Draft` columns). This workflow looks the lead up by `ts` and reads gmail thread id, lead email, subject, and pending draft from the row directly. Works on every Slack workspace tier including Free.

After a successful send (or mark manual), the two pending columns are cleared so a duplicate reaction won't re-fire.

## Required env
```
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=xoxb-...
SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL_ID=C0ASZ6R2K6E
SLACK_APPROVER_USER_ID=U0ARUAQ3NPN
GMAIL_SENDER=kevon@trymurmurai.app
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_APPROVAL_SLACK_TS=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_PENDING_DRAFT=...
```

## Slack app setup
1. In the Slack app config -> Event Subscriptions -> enable.
2. Request URL: paste the Production URL of the Slack Trigger below (n8n shows it after activating).
3. Subscribe bot events: `reaction_added`, `message.groups` (private channel messages).
4. Bot scopes (OAuth & Permissions): `chat:write`, `reactions:read`.
   - `groups:history` and `metadata:read` are NO LONGER REQUIRED.
5. Reinstall the app, invite the bot to `C0ASZ6R2K6E`.
6. Activate this workflow in n8n.

## Channel discipline
- This workflow ONLY listens to `SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL_ID` (C0ASZ6R2K6E).
- It posts confirmations back to the same approval channel.
- It NEVER touches `SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID` (C0AR99Q4ZUP). Channel-mixing is impossible by design.
